subject: Intake: template lineage, signer authority, and billing cadence — Pulsar Labs
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@pulsarlabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intake: template lineage, signer authority, and billing cadence — Pulsar Labs

Hi Anna —

Thanks for sending over the draft MSA yesterday. Before we start redlining on our side, a few quick intake questions to make sure we route the right template and approvals: 

- Which internal Pulsar template did you base the attached MSA on (if any)? exact filename or source doc helps (e.g., internal Sales MSA v3, or legacy vendor MSA).
- Who on your side has signature authority for platform agreements (title + email) and do you need a specific execution flow (single-signer vs signatory matrix)?
- Exhibit question: do you plan to include our proposed SSO / IdP exhibit as a firm ask or is that negotiable? we saw reference to SAML and an auth proxy in section 6.
- Billing cadence: do you prefer monthly invoicing in arrears, or quarterly? any PO / billing reference we should include on invoices?

Attachments: I attached a copy of the Pulsar draft we received to this thread. If you can return: the canonical template name, signatory contact, and preferred billing cadence by EOD tomorrow, we can align the contract template mapping and determine whether a limited redline or full MSA pass is needed.

Plan on our side: Kimberly will triage security and hosting exhibits; Dylan will scope the SLA/throughput clauses. I’ll own the commercial redlines and signer flow.

Thanks — short answers are fine. If it’s easier, we can do a 20-min sync this week.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Manager, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Anna Ruiz <anna@pulsarlabs.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal_ops@pulsarlabs.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: template lineage, signer authority, and billing cadence — Pulsar Labs

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below (I’ll attach the template we used):

- Template lineage: this is based on our internal "Commercial MSA v2" (file: PL-Commercial-MSA-v2.docx). We sometimes pull language from our legacy partner kit but this is the canonical internal doc.
- Signatory authority: primary signer is our VP of Finance, Maria Delgado (maria.delgado@pulsarlabs.com). For >$250k deals we require CFO sign-off; otherwise VP of Finance may sign.
- SSO Exhibit: we consider the SSO/IdP exhibit a scope item rather than a mandatory exhibit right now — we can be flexible on the exact controls but Pulsar wants SAML support and an option for Just-in-Time provisioning.
- Billing cadence: quarterly in arrears preferred; POs are optional but reference should be "Pulsar Labs — PL-PO" when provided.

I’m attaching the PL-Commercial-MSA-v2.docx and a separate Exhibit_SSO_v1.pdf (technical spec) — please let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Anna

Attachments: PL-Commercial-MSA-v2.docx (application/msword), Exhibit_SSO_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Anna Ruiz <anna@pulsarlabs.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: template lineage, signer authority, and billing cadence — Pulsar Labs

Thanks Anna — that helps. Internal next steps from Legal/Compliance POV: 

- I’ll do a targeted redline pass focused on data residency, audit rights, and the SSO exhibit (Exhibit_SSO_v1.pdf). If SSO is flexible, we’ll propose a narrow exhibit with our minimum controls + an ops checklist.
- Please confirm whether Pulsar requires SOC 2 Type II evidence; if so we’ll include our SOC 2 link and a short evidence bundle.
- For signature: if Maria Delgado is the primary signer and deal size may approach threshold, we’ll add an approval clause that triggers CFO notification for >$250k.

Dylan — can you review the SLA and throughput references in section 4 and flag anything that needs a performance exhibit (we have a standard Exhibit_Perf template we can attach)?

Anna — do you have an internal billing contact for quarterly invoices or should we send to maria.delgado@pulsarlabs.com? Also confirm whether Pulsar will require invoicing to a specific legal entity (Pulsar Labs, Inc. vs Pulsar Labs Global).

Planned cadence: Kimberly will return redlines within 2 business days after confirming SOC 2 ask. Stephanie to coordinate signature flow after we have redlines.

-Kimberly
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@pulsarlabs.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: template lineage, signer authority, and billing cadence — Pulsar Labs

Perfect — thanks team. Quick summary and owners so nothing falls through the cracks: 

- Anna: confirm billing legal entity and billing contact (reply by EOD Monday if possible).
- Kimberly: run targeted security/residency + SSO exhibit redline; planned turnaround 48 hours after SOC 2 confirmation.
- Dylan: flag any SLA/perf items that require Exhibit_Perf; share suggested exhibit by Monday.
- Stephanie (me): I’ll prepare the signatory matrix for execution and a short mutual action plan (MAP) doc to attach to the redline. I’ll also provision a HubSpot task (deal PL-2027-073) and a Drive folder (link below).

If anyone prefers a 15-min sync Monday 10am PT, I’ll set it up; otherwise we’ll proceed asynchronously.

Drive folder (working): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-pulsar-contracts
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/PL-2027-073

Thanks — moving to action.

—
Stephanie
Senior Manager, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
